headline: JSW Holdings Limited files Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: JSW Holdings Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition event or change in shareholding pattern requiring immediate regulatory notification to the exchange.
detail: JSW Holdings Limited, a steel and infrastructure conglomerate listed on NSE, has filed a formal disclosure with the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Code. This regulation requires disclosure when a person or group acquires, whether directly or indirectly, 5% or more of the voting capital of a listed company. The filing has been submitted to NSE and is available in the exchange archives, indicating the company or an acquirer has crossed a material shareholding threshold. The specific details of the acquiring party, the number of shares acquired, and the price/consideration are contained in the full disclosure document (Form A or amended disclosure) filed with the exchange.
